reason: I don't trust an app or AI with my customers' udhaar details. My paper diary is mine, and I already installed Khatabook once and stopped updating it, so why would this be different.
objection: Who sees my customers' udhaar names and amounts? If it picks up an order wrong, or a customer finds out his khata is sitting on some AI, I lose the customer. Free for 3 months and then they charge me, and I am back to my diary anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbouring shopkeeper I know personally has been using it for months and tells me the khata was never wrong or leaked, plus someone sits at my shop and sets it up beside my diary so I can run both side by side before I drop anything.
